conventions.convention: Point configurations are nonempty ordered lists in [0,1)^d; repetitions count with multiplicity. Star discrepancy is normalized by the list length and takes the supremum over half-open anchored boxes with endpoints in [0,1]^d.
The integer dimension d≥3 is fixed before n tends to infinity; n≥2, log is natural, and comparison constants and the eventual threshold may depend on d. The infimum need not be attained.
The singleton calculation assumes integer d≥2. A box contains the center exactly when every endpoint coordinate exceeds 1/2; the claimed discrepancy is approached by containing boxes.

load_bearing.statement: For a nonempty ordered point list P in [0,1)^d, D_N^*(P) is the supremum over u∈[0,1]^d of the absolute difference between the fraction of entries in ∏[0,u_j) and ∏u_j.
For an integer d≥2, the singleton configuration at (1/2,…,1/2) has star discrepancy D_1^*(P)=1−2^(−d), giving 3/4 in dimension two and 7/8 in dimension three.

published_dependencies.used_for: Exact configuration, normalization, multiplicity and half-open anchored-box conventions. The example's F1 faithfully restates this definition, and its case split and limiting boxes establish the stated supremum.
